interface: For arbitrary Type I with Fintype I and DecidableEq I, real w with forall i, 0 <= w i, Option-real v, real t and finite E, the explicit hypotheses knownExceedance v t subset E and E subset knownExceedance v t union undefinedEvent v imply sum_K w <= sum_E w and sum_E w <= sum_K w + sum_U w.

definitions.knownExceedance: Finset.univ.filter (fun i => exists x, v i = some x and t < x)

strict_boundary_theorem: PORTCAS07FiniteStrictExceedance.threshold_equality_excluded: v i = some t implies i notin knownExceedance v t.
method: Subset monotonicity of finite nonnegative weighted sums and disjoint union sum identity.
boundary_scope: The statement permits empty finite types/events and zero weights. It assumes no mass normalization and performs no survivor renormalization.
